reported_observation: The evacuation alert appears visually but produces neither spoken evacuation text nor the repeating alarm tone while screen-reader focus is inside the incident-details panel.
reproduction_result: Reproduced 5 of 5 times on two reference phones using test EVT-RED-17.
evidence_reference: Run log A11Y-482 and audio trace AUD-119 show the accessibility-focus handler suppressing both announcement and alarm-audio events.
expected_behavior: The evacuation instruction is spoken and the repeating alarm tone continues until acknowledged.
observed_behavior: Only the visual red banner appears; navigation text is announced, but the evacuation instruction and alarm tone are silent.
product_safety_disposition: Release blocker; correct the focus-handler path and pass TalkBack alert-output regression tests before release.

reported_observation: The shelter-location link is announced as unlabeled after the first alarm update.
reproduction_result: Reproduced 4 of 4 times in the desktop reference environment.
evidence_reference: Accessibility tree captures AX-208 and AX-209 show the link losing its accessible name after live-region refresh.
expected_behavior: The link retains the label Shelter location after every update.
observed_behavior: The link is announced only as link after the first refresh.
product_safety_disposition: Major defect; restore the accessible name and include live-region refresh coverage in the release test.

reported_observation: Scanning focus skips the Acknowledge button for one full cycle after an alarm opens.
reproduction_result: Reproduced 4 of 4 times with the standard six-item scan profile.
evidence_reference: Input trace SW-341 records focus moving from Details directly to Status during the first scan cycle.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge is reachable in the first scan cycle.
observed_behavior: Acknowledge becomes reachable only during the second cycle, adding 18 to 22 seconds.
product_safety_disposition: Major defect; correct initial focus order and repeat the standard scan-profile test.

reported_observation: At the largest system text size, the final word of the evacuation-zone label wraps outside its panel.
reproduction_result: Reproduced 5 of 5 times on the reference compact phone.
evidence_reference: Layout captures UI-773 through UI-777 show the same clipped zone label while audio and vibration remain active.
expected_behavior: The full evacuation-zone label remains visible at supported text sizes.
observed_behavior: The last word is clipped at the largest text size.
product_safety_disposition: Moderate defect; allow the panel to expand and rerun large-text layout tests.

reported_observation: The alarm-source status is partially hidden when magnification is above 300 percent.
reproduction_result: Reproduced 3 of 3 times at 350 percent magnification.
evidence_reference: Viewport captures MAG-553 through MAG-555 show the status under the fixed command bar.
expected_behavior: The alarm-source status remains reachable and visible under magnification.
observed_behavior: The final status line is obscured until magnification is reduced.
product_safety_disposition: Moderate defect; make the content region scrollable and verify at 300 and 400 percent.

reported_observation: The first word of an evacuation instruction was reportedly repeated during one session.
reproduction_result: Not reproduced in 0 of 6 controlled runs using the supplied event sequence.
evidence_reference: Run set A11Y-491 contains no duplicate announcement, and the original session has no audio trace.
expected_behavior: Each evacuation instruction is announced once.
observed_behavior: No duplicate announcement occurred in the controlled runs.
product_safety_disposition: Needs additional evidence; record as not reproduced and do not classify it as a confirmed defect.
